embeds.title: ARTICLE III — FRANCHISE OWNERSHIP, DUES, AND PRIZES
embeds.description:
Annual dues are **$50 per franchise**. At startup, each franchise pays **$100**, covering the first season and the following season in advance. The league is intended to remain one season prepaid thereafter.

A franchise is a single dues obligation even when co-owners are present.

**Current annual allocation**
• 12 franchises: $600
• Fantrax Premium budget: $129.95
• League Champion: $250
• Runner-Up: $100
• Presidents’ Trophy: $75
• Third Place: $25
• Regular-Season Fantasy Points Leader: $20

Any residual amount remains league treasury unless otherwise approved.
